{"items":[{"item_id":"h021","prompts":["I'm building a food delivery app for HarmonyOS and I want the order status to show up on the live notification card so the user can track the courier without opening the app. Can you generate the code to set up that card when an order starts, update it as the status changes, and remove it when the order is delivered?"],"rubric":["Provides ArkTS code to create a live view for a delivery order","Includes code to update the live view as order status changes","Includes code to stop or remove the live view on completion","Code follows HarmonyOS LiveView Kit APIs correctly"]},{"item_id":"h022","prompts":["I need to add notification support to my HarmonyOS app so my server can send users alerts when their saved items go on sale. Please show me how to get the device token and set everything up to send notification messages."],"rubric":["Explains how to obtain the push token in an ArkTS app","Covers the push service configuration/enablement steps","Shows how to send a notification message","Does not require credentials or paid services to follow the core steps"]},{"item_id":"h023","prompts":["My HarmonyOS app looks fine on phones but the layout gets stretched and text truncates on tablets and foldables. I want the content to reflow responsively across screen sizes and orientations — how should I restructure the layout with breakpoints and adaptive components? Here's a simplified version of my page: a Column with a title Text, an Image with width 360, and two buttons in a Row."],"rubric":["Suggests responsive layout approach using breakpoints (e.g., GridRow/GridCol)","Addresses the fixed 360-width image stretching issue","Handles component adaptation (layoutWeight, aspectRatio, etc.)","Considers both phone and tablet/foldable form factors"]},{"item_id":"h024","prompts":["My HarmonyOS app crashes right after tapping a product card in the release build. Here's the faultlogger excerpt: Reason:Error, Error name:TypeError, Error message:Cannot read property 'price' of undefined, Stacktrace: at ProductPage.onClick (pages/ProductPage.ets:12), with buildModule#sourcemap.js. Can you analyze the crash and tell me the root cause and how to fix it?"],"rubric":["Identifies TypeError caused by accessing 'price' on undefined data","Points to ProductPage.ets line 12 as the crash location","Explains how to deobfuscate the stack via SourceMap","Gives a concrete fix such as null/undefined checking"]},{"item_id":"h025","prompts":["I have a product catalog feature that needs to ship simultaneously on HarmonyOS, Android, and iOS: a list screen that fetches products from a JSON API and a detail screen. Please run the full cross-platform pipeline — produce the technical design, per-platform implementation plans, the actual code for all three, and build/verify steps."],"rubric":["Produces a cross-platform technical design covering all three platforms","Provides implementation plans per platform","Delivers working code for HarmonyOS, Android, and iOS","Includes build and verification steps"]},{"item_id":"h026","prompts":["I have a signed HarmonyOS release package and I want to automate uploading it and submitting it for review on the Huawei app store instead of doing it through the AGC web console. Show me how to log in with the CLI, find my app's App ID, upload the APP package, and trigger a release submission."],"rubric":["Shows CLI login and logout commands","Shows how to query the App ID for an existing app","Covers uploading the APP/release package","Covers submitting the app for release review"]},{"item_id":"h027","prompts":["I maintain a bilingual API reference document and I'm worried the English parameter tables have drifted from the Chinese descriptions. Here's a sample section:

## updateConfig

更新配置。更新指定配置项。

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Mandatory | Description |
| -------- | -------- | -------- | -------- |
| configId | string | Yes | 配置ID，用于标识唯一配置。 |
| timeout | number | No | 超时时间，单位为秒。 |

Please check this section for inconsistencies between the Chinese and English content and any description accuracy issues."],"rubric":["Identifies that the parameters table is Chinese-only while the doc is expected to be bilingual","Flags the missing English translations for the two parameters","Checks parameter types and mandatory flags for accuracy","Reports issues in a clear, actionable list"]},{"item_id":"h028","prompts":["I need to build my HarmonyOS app from the command line for a CI pipeline instead of opening DevEco Studio every time. Show me how to compile the HAP, do a clean rebuild, and what the typical command looks like in a CI script."],"rubric":["Provides the hvigorw command for building a HAP (e.g., assembleHap)","Includes the clean command for rebuilds","Mentions relevant parameters/options for CI usage","Commands are accurate for the Hvigor build tool"]},{"item_id":"h029","prompts":["I'm integrating Huawei's payment SDK in my HarmonyOS app with a Spring Boot backend, but purchases fail with a signature verification error in my callback handler. My ArkTS client calls request with the order info from my server, and the server validates the notify using the public key from the merchant portal. What are the common causes of callback verification failures and how do I fix them?"],"rubric":["Identifies likely causes of callback signature verification failure","Covers server-side (Spring Boot) verification setup","Mentions sandbox testing for diagnosis","Gives concrete fix suggestions"]},{"item_id":"h030","prompts":["When users tap a photo thumbnail in my gallery list, I want the image to smoothly expand into a full-screen viewer with a continuous shared-element feel — the kind of fluid card-expanding transition you see in modern iOS apps — instead of the abrupt default page change. How do I implement that in my HarmonyOS ArkUI app?"],"rubric":["Recommends a custom transition approach (e.g., custom NavContentInfo transition)","Includes shared-element style animation between thumbnail and full image","Provides ArkTS code for the transition","Handles the reverse (close) transition back to the list"]}]}
